acquisition_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode to automatically switch between MS and MS/MS acquisition.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Peptides were obtained through trypsin reaction (1:50 w/w) (Promega) and then desalted using STAGE-TIPs.

collision_energy.evidence: General mass spectrometry conditions were: electrospray voltage, 2.0 kV; no sheath and auxiliary gas flow, heated capillary temperature of 250°C, normalized HCD collision energy 25%.

fragmentation_method.evidence: for fragmentation on the HCD cell using high-energy collision dissociation at a target value of 100,000 charges or maximum acquisition time of 100 ms.

ionization_type.evidence: equipped with a nanoelectrospray ion source (EasySpray/Thermo).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Normalized label-free quantification (LFQ) intensity values were imported into the R software and paired t-tests were used to identify differently expressed proteins.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: All experiments were performed on an Easy nLC1000 nano-LC system connected to a quadrupole–Orbitrap (QExactive) mass spectrometer (ThermoElectron, Bremen, Germany) equipped with a nanoelectrospray ion source (EasySpray/Thermo).

ptm.evidence: Parameters were set as follow: protein N-acetylation, methionine oxidation and pyrogluatamte conversion of Glu and Gln as variable modifications.
